reading_guide: an example is a place to go and look: map, the sector to stand in, and the object's own index
examples are taken one map at a time, in map order, so they are spread across the campaign and are not a ranking
read_as and worked_by are `bloodmap.effects`' reading of the moving sectors of that type; a name from where a thing sits, never from its type
an effect is defined by the XSECTOR fields listed under `fields` and by nothing else
cited_by is library code whose docstring names the lesson
a channel entry counts who sends on and who listens to one of the engine's reserved channels; its examples are the senders

effect:conveyor.name: conveyor
effect:conveyor.says: the floor pans and drag is set: what stands on it is carried

effect:panning floor.name: panning floor
effect:panning floor.says: the floor's texture pans and drag is not set

effect:depth.name: depth
effect:depth.says: the floor has a sinking depth: a body stands in it, not on it

effect:damage.name: damage
effect:damage.says: the sector hurts what is in it; damage_type says how

effect:crush.name: crush
effect:crush.says: crush is set: the moving sector does not stop for a body

effect:wind.name: wind
effect:wind.says: the sector pushes what is in it; wind_angle says which way

effect:bob.name: bob
effect:bob.says: the floor or ceiling bobs up and down

effect:shade wave.name: shade wave
effect:shade wave.says: the sector's shade animates; shade_wave says with which wave

effect:locked.name: locked
effect:locked.says: the sector starts locked and something must unlock it

effect:enter trigger.name: enter trigger
effect:enter trigger.says: walking into the sector sets it off

effect:exit trigger.name: exit trigger
effect:exit trigger.says: walking out of the sector sets it off

effect:push trigger.name: push trigger
effect:push trigger.says: pressing Use while standing in the sector sets it off

effect:wall push trigger.name: wall push trigger
effect:wall push trigger.says: pressing Use against one of the sector's walls sets it off

effect:shot trigger.name: shot trigger
effect:shot trigger.says: a shot into the sector sets it off
